collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: On the first day of the rains, a Heathen has a pocketful of stones to drop into the stream.

description_variants.description: On the first day of the rains, an Isolan has a pocketful of stones to drop into the stream.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: On the first day of the rains, the Heathens have a custom: everyone drops a stone into the stream for each person they miss, and watches the water carry the ripples away. (name1) has a pocketful of stones this year. More than last year.

variants.text: On the first day of the rains, the Isolans have a custom: everyone drops a stone into the stream for each person they miss, and watches the water carry the ripples away. (name1) has a pocketful of stones this year. More than last year.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) drops each stone separately, waiting for the ripples to fade before the next. It takes a long time. Nobody hurries (him/her). When (he/she) is finished (he/she) washes (his/her) face in the stream and goes to help with supper.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) drops all but one. The last stone (he/she) keeps, and carries for the rest of the season. Nobody asks about it. There is no rule that says you have to let all of them go at once. \(no effect\)
